title: Ensuring Stall Rentals at Trade Fairs and Bazaars Remain Affordable
what_it_is: Ensuring Stall Rentals at Trade Fairs and Bazaars Remain Affordable

sections.label: PA sets trade fair conditions
sections.summary: The People's Association does not run the trade fair but sets conditions and specifications for the operator to ensure a suitable, conducive and safe environment.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Whilst the People's Association (PA) does not run the trade fair or bazaar, it sets the relevant conditions and specifications for the successful operator to ensure that the event is held in a suitable, conducive and safe environment for stall operators and patrons alike.

sections.label: Tenderer sets stall rental rates
sections.summary: The successful tenderer sets stall rental rates based on factors such as duration, location and type of business, based on market rates.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: The successful tenderer then also sets the relevant rental rates for the stalls, having regard to factors, such as the duration and location of the event and the type of business based on market rates.

sections.label: Home-based businesses and community groups
sections.summary: A bazaar section is reserved for home-based businesses at $55 per day, and community groups are given complimentary space at no charge.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: In an effort to support home-based businesses, a section of the bazaar is reserved for them where they are given stalls at a low-cost rental, which is at $55 per day.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Various community groups, such as the National Kidney Foundation, the Malay Youth Literary Association (4PM) and also Jamiyah Singapore, are provided with complimentary space at no charge.

sections.label: Open tender reflects market price
sections.summary: The open tender that is conducted reflects the market price.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: The open tender, which is conducted, reflects the market price.

sections.label: Best expertise and proposal
sections.summary: The point is not to get the bidder with the highest price but the bidder with the best expertise and best proposal.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: As I had mentioned, the point is not to get the bidder with the highest price but the bidder with the best expertise and the best proposal.

sections.label: Operator publishes rates charged
sections.summary: The operator publishes the rates that it wants to charge.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: To the point that Mr Faisal makes, the operator publishes the rates that it wants to charge.

sections.label: Stallholder rental recoupment evidence
sections.summary: PA does not require all stallholders to declare profits, but anecdotal evidence suggests some recouped rental expenses around the midway point.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: To Mr Faisal's point, whilst we do not require all the stallholders to declare their profits or otherwise to PA, we have some anecdotal evidence to suggest that some of the stallholders some time around the midway point had recouped their rental expenses.
